selected_candidate.new_module_purpose: Standalone module-level functions for boolean query/intent predicates over user message strings. Pure, side-effect free, deterministic. No coupling to BrainSession runtime state.

symbols_to_move.function_renames: All 31 methods become module-level functions; the leading underscore is preserved to mark them as internal API. The `self` parameter is dropped. Bodies are unchanged.

selected_candidate.symbols_to_reexport_from_session_py: All 31 names remain available as bound instance methods on `BrainSession` via thin shims. No public-API change.
module_level_constants_to_redeclare_in_n: _CODE_ANALYSIS_PATH_RE — recompiled locally OR imported from session.py (must avoid circular import; recompile preferred)
session_py_changes_required: Insert near top of class body: `from brain_v9.core import session_query_predicates as _qp` (or import at module level above class)
Replace 31 `def _is_*` / `def _looks_like_*` method bodies with one-line delegations
Keep `_CODE_ANALYSIS_PATH_RE` definition in session.py unchanged (used elsewhere)
selected_candidate.main_py_changes_required: NONE — main.py calls predicates as bound methods on BrainSession instance; shims preserve this exactly.

tests_recommended.purpose: Verify backward-compat shim: BrainSession instance still has each predicate as bound method, returning identical results vs new standalone functions for a battery of representative inputs.
Exercise the new standalone functions over a small input matrix per predicate (positive + negative + edge case) to lock behavior.

validations_recommended: Phase 1 baseline: powershell phase1_local_validation.ps1, test_phase1_import_baseline, test_phase1_security_defaults
Pre-existing predicate consumers: tests/unit/test_brain_chat_hygiene.py, test_confirmation_bug_fix.py, test_grounded_code_fastpath.py, test_b7_routing_heuristics_characterization.py
Routing-related regression: test_chat_metrics_extended.py, test_contradiction_learning_layer.py, test_semantic_coherence_validation.py, test_fases_2_3_4_routing_analytics.py
Import smoke: from brain_v9.core.session import BrainSession; assert all 31 predicate methods present and callable
selected_candidate.rollback_plan: Single-commit revert: `git revert <b7-03 commit>` is sufficient (one new module + edits to session.py + 2 new test files). All changes are mechanical — bodies copied verbatim into module-level functions, shims replace original methods. No state-machine, persistence-layout, or import-graph changes.

risk_assessment.circular_import_risk: very_low (new module imports only stdlib re/json; session.py imports new module)
risk_assessment.behavior_change_risk: very_low (verbatim body copy; only `self` parameter dropped from signatures)
risk_assessment.test_regression_risk: very_low (tests call predicates on instance — shims cover this 1:1)
risk_assessment.performance_risk: negligible (one extra function-call frame per shim invocation; predicates are not hot-path-sensitive)

rejected_alternatives_summary.C2_routing_constants: Lower payoff (~145L); preferable to land second to consolidate `from session import AGENT_KEYWORDS` consumers without breaking shim test pattern.
rejected_alternatives_summary.C6_slash_command_handlers: Higher payoff (~740L) but heavy `self.*` coupling. Should follow C1 to validate shim methodology at scale before tackling.
rejected_alternatives_summary.C7_tool01_subsystem: Mixed I/O + governance + permission state; needs deeper audit.
rejected_alternatives_summary.C8_format_helpers: Mixed coupling per method; needs split into pure-formatter vs session-aware sub-groups.
